correctness.rationale: The identity f=xf′+1 makes all the degree-five branch polynomials separable. Six tame branch points give genus four. Local orders at five zeros and infinity certify the four-form basis; the exact 2^{-1}-linear Cartier action sends (e1,e2,e3,e4) to (e4+sqrt(a)e3+sqrt(b)e2,0,e1,0). The image span(e1,w) is two-dimensional, Cartier(w)=a^{1/4}e1 and iteration has ranks (2,1,0,0) when a=0 or (2,2,2,2) otherwise. The derivative is a squared quadratic, so its distinct-root number is one or two according to a. Standalone verification succeeds for 1,364 finite-field coefficient pairs and independent F2 zeta numerator checks. The symbolic proof, not finite enumeration, establishes the universal assertion.

The general genus-four canonical matrix (Dragutinović) is a computational method rather than a statement of the exact rank-zero parameter divisor.

originality.rationale: The exact stable Cartier-rank jump on a=0, its independence of b, its polynomial-critical-point interpretation and its marked-coefficient counts were not identified in the inspected genus-four characteristic-two or general superelliptic sources. The closest published genus-four source treats general Newton and Ekedahl-Oort strata, not this family’s two-rank parameter divisor. Indexed search limitations remain explicitly acknowledged.

value.rationale: Characteristic-two genus-four p-rank and Ekedahl-Oort stratification are established algebraic-geometric research themes (Dragutinović 2023). On an everywhere-smooth naturally marked cyclic trigonal genus-four family, the theorem computes the full arithmetic rank jump locus despite constant one-step Cartier rank two, identifies its exact critical-point collision mechanism, and counts geometric p-rank strata over every finite extension. The precise invariant and locus are motivated by genus-four Torelli arithmetic and are not a mere isomorphism rewording or an isolated field calculation. It does not claim new general a-number formulas.
